violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed ownership rinse his hands in at the 3-compartment sink on two separate instances
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS DIRECTED OWNERSHIP TO ALWAYS WASH HANDS IN THE HAND SINK. HAND SINK IS FOR HAND WASHING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) horseradish sauce 2) cooked onions 3) refried beans
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS. EHS PROVIDED OWNERSHIP A DATE MARKING FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign at the hand sink in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A HAND WASHING SIGN TO POST AT THE HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Proper Temp
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding to a sufficient temperature and/or time: stewed eggplant was observed at 148f being reheated on the stove. Eggplant was cooked the day prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT ALL LEFTOVER FOOD TO 165f BEFORE PUTTING IN THE STEAM WELL. STAFF HEATED THE EGGPLANT TO 173f.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the counter top steam well: curried chickpeas (153f), chicken soup (123f), lentil soup (83f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT THE FOOD ON THE STOVE TO 165f. PIC MOVED ALL OF THE FOOD TO THE STOVE TO REHEAT PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed 3 bottles of home use pesticides being stored under the front counter.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD THE HOME USE PESTICIDES. CONTACT A LICENSED PEST CONTROL COMPANY FOR SERVICES. DO NOT USED HOME USE PESTICIDES IN A COMMERCIAL FACILITY. STAFF DISCARDED THE PESTICIDES.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in a countertop steam well, chickpeas were observed at 109f-125f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM REHEATED THE CHICKPEAS ON THE STOVE TO 199f.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CALL THE FAIRFAX COUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT (703-246-2201) TO GET GUIDANCE ON HOW TO REPRINT OR OBTAIN THE PAPER 2025 PERMIT.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff change gloves without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC THAT STAFF NEED TO WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING ON GLOVES. SEE WHEN TO WASH HANDOUT. PLEASE TRAIN STAFF ON WHEN TO WASH.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: Observed milk (45f), half and half (45f), and oat milk (45f) in the 2DR prep top cooler at the coffee station. The cooler was observed at 40f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH STAFF TO MOVE ALL BEVERAGES FROM THE COOLER TO THE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR TO BRING THEM TO 41f. THE LID OF THE PREP TOP SHOULD REMAIN CLOSED TO KEEP FOOD AT THE PROPER TEMPERATURE.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: Observed no consumer advisory disclosure on the new menu for salmon, steak, hamburger, and eggs.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO APPLY THE THEIR OLD CONSUMER ADVISORY STICKER ONTO THE NEW MENUS. EHS MARKED ALL OF THE FOOD ITEMS THAT NEED AN ASTERISK. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed a container of coffee machine cleaner being stored with to-go ketchup packets.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. STAFF MOVED THE CONTAINER OF CLEANER TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed a bottle of Advil being stored with the coffee syrups at the coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. STAFF MOVED THE ADVIL TO THE FIRST AID AREA. OLIVE EXPRESS (Inspection Date: 03/26/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed many boxes of single service utensils, boxes of catering equipment, cases of soda and beverages, etc. being stored directly on the floor throughout the dining area and at the coffee station.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF THAT ALL OF THE BOXES NEED TO BE ELEVATED OFF OF THE FLOOR IN ORDER TO CLEAN THOROUGHLY. USE NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. MULTIPLE VIOLATIONS MAY WARRANT ENFORCEMENT. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
